title: Geo-affinity selector + failsafe variant validator (compiler and runtime checks)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Refactor the rule intake and validation path for region/tier selection and fallback model variants. Deliver a compact compiler that emits canonical selector IR, a validator that enforces compatibility constraints between region affinity, tier preferences and model variant fallbacks, and a lightweight runtime check used during canary rollouts. This ticket covers design, schema changes, validator implementation, unit tests, and a small migration tool to convert existing policy configs into the new canonical form.
background: Current routing rules have accumulated ad-hoc fields for region overrides, tier weighting, and fallback model variants. This leads to surprising interactions: a regional override can silently defeat a configured local-only tier; fallbacks sometimes select incompatible quantization profiles. We need an explicit validation and canonicalization pass so operators can safely author policies and the runtime can make deterministic routing decisions under capacity pressure.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical selector IR is defined and documented for region selection, tier routing, and fallback variant chains
A validator rejects configs that would produce incompatible variant sequences (e.g., fallback to a model with incompatible kv-cache format)
Unit tests cover positive and negative cases for regional affinity, tier fallsbacks, and cross-field interactions
Migration utility converts >95% of existing org policies without manual edits; remaining failures are surfaced with actionable error messages
Canary runtime check emits deterministic diagnostics in Console for rollout testing and does not add >2% p50 latency to selector execution
tech_notes: Design IR as a flat sequence: [scope predicates] -> [priority score adjustments] -> [variant candidate list with metadata]
Introduce a compatibility matrix for model artifact properties (kv-cache format, quantization family, tokenizer compat) used by validator
Validator runs at policy push time; runtime performs a lightweight recheck during canary to ensure no drift between compiled IR and live metadata

Prefer declarative errors with remediation hints (example: "fallback chain stops at 'mosaic-v2-quant' which lacks kv-cache format required by 'mosaic-v1' primary. Consider adding a conversion variant or restricting fallback tiers")
tasks: Implement schema extension: add 'variant_metadata' block with keys: kv_cache_format, tokenizer_profile, quant_family
Build validator library with clear error codes and remediation strings
Add migration tool that emits transformed config and conflict report
Hook validator into policy push API and CI checks
Author unit + integration tests (policy unit tests, integration with runtime stubs)
Add lightweight runtime recheck in canary path and Console diagnostics
